run.title: golden-butterfly-001 / Golden Butterfly 五袖001; fixed growth-value-bond-gold diversification

strategies.description: A fixed equal-weight mix of broad U.S. equity, small-cap value, long Treasuries, short Treasury bills and gold can combine the Permanent Portfolio all-regime defense with a dedicated small-cap-value return premium. Annual rebalancing should preserve low turnover while harvesting cross-asset diversification and the long-only value premium, potentially improving CAGR versus the Permanent Portfolio without sacrificing drawdown control.
